hints.content: The wrestler *gained* weight each month, so we expect to have a *positive* slope.
The wrestler weighed $79.5$ kilograms when he started his diet, so we expect a *positive* $y$-intercept.

Based on this description, we expect a positive slope and a positive $y$-intercept.

question.content:
A young sumo wrestler decided to go on a special high-protein diet to gain weight rapidly. When he started his diet, he weighed $79.5$ kilograms. He gained weight at a rate of $5.5$ kilograms per month.

Let $y$ represent the sumo wrestler's weight (in kilograms) after $x$ months.

**Which of the following could be the graph of the relationship?**
